understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by activating all goal cells. A goal activates only when the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation exactly match the goal's requirements before stepping onto it.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life while restoring stamina to its maximum; losing all lives ends the game. Walls cannot be crossed, so blocked_directions must be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Stamina refill tiles restore stamina, and completing all goals advances to the next level.
